name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human
native_kbm_note: No source found showing keyboard/mouse gameplay support on PS5; every PS5 guide lists DualSense controls only. Not explicitly confirmed by an official statement.
notes: The PS5 layout is solid: outsidergaming, magicgameworld and gamenguides agree (R1 jump, R2 attack, L1 block, L2 use equipment, L1+R2 kick, hold X heal, Circle crouch, Square use, Triangle look back, R3 survivor sense, D-pad up consumables, down flashlight, left accessories, right weapons, Touchpad player menu, Options pause). The PC guides conflict. Block = RMB is confirmed by Steam users (hard-bound). Kick = E follows gamepur and brgeeks, but the in-game loading tips on the wiki say F. Crouch is C in the guides and LCtrl in the loading tips, so both are mapped. The loading tips also say Tab = extended HUD, but the guides say Tab (hold) = weapons menu, so Tab -> D-pad right is uncertain. MMB (use accessory / throwables) -> L2 is inferred. Left out because no reliable PC key was found: cycle consumables, grappling hook (Alt), reload/next weapon (R, which the guides overlap).
